sourceNotes.rawContent: Exude classic charm with this premium maroon chevron enamel kada. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure your jewelry retains its rich color and shine. This elegant, patterned statement piece offers a luxurious, modern aesthetic that maintains its stunning luster through everyday wear.
